text:
sahil: Quick PSA  staging-3 has a slot collision: HW partner hero scheduled same time as our marketplace listing cutover. Need quick decision on avoid/shift.

maria: which time are we talking? press embargo is locked to the slot I think.

sahil: scheduled at 00:30 UTC 2026-04-02 (17:30 PT). partner asked for hero + cert banner then.

jen: if embargo is fixed we can either delay listing by 30m or change hero deployment timing. @kevin which is less risky?

kevin: moving the listing is heavier (CDN invalidation + potential TTL issues). moving hero is safer if partner can accept.

maria: partner insists hero goes live at publish time with blog. sync is non-negotiable for their PR.

tao: alternative: deploy assets earlier but keep a hidden toggle so the hero only surfaces on the publish event. Console toggle supports scheduled flips.

jen: that is exactly what I was thinking. ops flips on embargo lift, avoid busy staging slot.

kevin: confirmed, toggle exists. ops needs exact S3 path and UTM/promo strings for verification. ask partner to upload to s3://redwood-marketplace/hw/partnerX/assets/hero-v3/ and include a screenshot.

nina: I've asked partner to upload and to complete SI pre-cert steps; flagged that they skipped step 4 (egress rules). they said they'll push an update by EOD.

maria: embargo still 17:30 PT, correct? we must not flip before designers and PR confirm.

sahil: correct. plan proposal: assets by 15:00 PT, ops preview at 16:00 PT, flip at 17:30 PT.

launchbot: calendar reminders set: preview @ 16:00 PT, toggle-flip @ 17:30 PT, post-launch checklist attached.

tao: SI integration note  after partner finishes network egress step we run a tokened health check from SI subnet. suggested quick check for SI: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://si.partnerx.com/health | jq .status`

kevin: ops will run the health check post-flip as a sanity check. also scheduling CDN purge 10m after flip to clear edge caches.

maria: marketing teams ready; need final analytics string and promo code. anyone confirm?

nina: partner confirmed utm_source=partnerX&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=launch_2026 and promo=PARTNERX20. added to assets doc.

jen: owners pinned: assets=nina, ops=kevin+tao, press=maria, partner-liaison=sahil. Preview agenda (16:00): visual QA, toggle preview, smoke test dry-run, legal check on crediting.

sahil: quick copy-paste checklist for the channel:
``n- 15:00 PT: partner uploads hero v3 + 2 screenshots
- 16:00 PT: ops preview on staging-3 (toggle enabled for preview)
- 17:00 PT: legal signoff on partner crediting copy
- 17:30 PT: embargo lift -> toggle flip -> publish blog
- 17:40 PT: CDN purge (10m after flip) -> confirm analytics events
- 18:00 PT: SI smoke test & final verification
```

maria: sounds good. I'll be on preview/watch for flip and will confirm blog PR at 16:30.

kevin: ops will standby in #release-war-room. will coordinate edge purge timing with CDN provider.

nina: pinged partner and they uploaded hero_v3 and sitemap. preview link: https://staging-3.redwood.ai/partnerX/hero-preview

tao: preview looks good but mobile crop needs slight tweak. flagged partner to adjust.

partner-bot: event: asset-upload partnerX/hero_v3 by partnerX_user at 15:07 PT.

sahil: great. toggle approach resolves slot collision. fallback: move HW hero to 18:00 PT if anything blocks.

jen: I'll do legal crediting at 17:00 and post result.

maria: blog PR merged and set to publish on toggle flip. :tada:

kevin: ops confirms staging preview ok. will run purge 10m after flip to minimize cache issues.

sahil: closing loop unless SI checklist or assets lag. thanks team :thumbsup:
